name: release-brief
title: INTERNAL DRAFT: Release readiness brief
for_each: select id,code from releases order by code

sections.title: Tasks
sections.sql: select code,name,owner,due,completed_at from tasks where release_id=$1 order by code

sections.title: Approval history
sections.sql: select revision,reviewer,note,created_at from approvals where release_id=$1 order by created_at

name: audience-review
title: INTERNAL DRAFT: Audience consent review
for_each: select id,code from projects order by code

sections.title: Audience
sections.sql: select email,status,categories,consent_recorded from audience_readiness where project_id=$1 order by email
sections.note: Recorded evidence only. This report does not send messages or certify consent.
